mapper.select: SELECT FROM merchant_payout_attempts WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM merchant_payout_attempts WHERE statement_id=#{statement} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC
SELECT FROM merchant_payout_attempts WHERE status IN ('REQUESTED','PENDING') AND next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY next_attempt_at,id LIMIT 10
mapper.update: UPDATE merchant_payout_attempts SET status=#{status},channel_payout_no=#{channel},resolved_at=#{resolvedAt}, next_attempt_at=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,5,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('REQUESTED','PENDING')
UPDATE merchant_payout_attempts SET next_attempt_at=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,5,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('REQUESTED','PENDING')
